text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "other countries regard these occasions when they invite or receive the Swiss president as a ‘state visit’", "gist": "Other countries consider invitations or receptions of the Swiss president as state visits"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "It is up to the country issuing the invitation to decide whether it is for a working visit, an official visit or a state visit, with the full honours dictated by protocol", "gist": "The inviting country determines the visit type and honors according to protocol"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Swiss presidents only pay presidential visits, but on occasion are received on state visits by their foreign hosts", "gist": "Swiss presidents make presidential visits but are sometimes hosted on state visits by foreign leaders"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The concept of the state visit presents no problems when foreign heads of state come to Switzerland, because they are received by all seven members of the Federal Council", "gist": "State visits to Switzerland cause no issues as foreign heads of state are received by all seven Federal Council members"}]}
